changelog: Fixes a home-screen error (no cards) that could occur when Taste-driven discovery was enabled: the 'What people are watching in your country' row built a database query that could not be translated to SQL. Home row providers now also fail safe, so one broken row can never blank the whole home. (1.0.5.0 added taste-driven discovery, per-user taste profiles, recommendation memory, self-explaining For You, richer taste signals, household time zone, retention, and /Admin/Diagnostics.)
description: Server-side intelligence engine for the Orca X TV app: personalization, recommendations, caching, and centralized administration.
name: Orca Engine
overview: The brain/backbone for the Orca X Android TV client.
